Hymn 309: As Sisters in Zion
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: A-flat Major
Composer: Janice Kapp Perry
Lyricist/Text Author: Emily H. Woodmansee
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 309 titled "As Sisters in Zion" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A-flat Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Janice Kapp Perry and the lyrics were written by Emily H. Woodmansee.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
